svg.title: A self-consistent periodic charge mode can decay or oscillate
svg.desc: A periodic electron-density perturbation delta n=A0 a(s) cos(qx) obeys a double prime+a prime+Omega squared a=0, s=t/tau, a(0)=1, a prime(0)=0. Curves use Omega=0.2 and 1.2. The spatial snapshot uses Omega=1.2 and s=1, a=0.52663969, a prime=-0.71019864. Normalized density equals a cos(qx), normalized electric field equals minus a sin(qx), and normalized conventional current equals a prime sin(qx). This is a periodic collective electron-fluid density mode, not a quantum wavefunction or an electrode-biased uniform wire.
svg.text: A periodic density perturbation relaxes or oscillates
